title: Credentials gating: release checklist and decision trace
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD follow-up ticket to consolidate requirements clarifications, scope change log, and a deterministic signoff checklist for SSO (SAML/OIDC), RBAC, audit logs, and KMS/HSM operator controls for private/VPC/on‑prem deliveries. This ticket is the final gating artifact for the 2026.03 private release: it ties customer-facing acceptance criteria to engineering test artifacts and the security review runbook. Owner: PM. Outcome: one executable checklist that security, infra, and customer ops can use to declare readiness.
scope_decisions: Keep SAML v2.0 federation as mandatory; OIDC support documented as optional-compat for customers that request it
RBAC: deliver fine-grained role matrix for admin/operator/read-only; scoped tokens (session-limited) deferred to a follow-up cycle
Audit logs must be exported to customer-managed S3/Blob with signed URLs and retention controls; local audit-forwarding to SIEM tested in staging
KMS integration: support both AWS KMS and external HSM via PKCS#11; HSM quorum tests required only for on-prem airgapped customers
Scope change: rotated key escrow (3rd-party escrow) was removed from MVP and recorded as consequence for PM-22469
security_controls: SSO: SAML metadata import UI + CLI, SAML metadata validation, signed assertions validation, X.509 cert rotation guidance
RBAC: policy docs, least-privilege templates, role inheritance matrix, API-level enforcement tests
Audit: structured JSON line logs with schema v1.2, WORM option for retention, real-time checksum verification in staging
KMS/HSM: envelope encryption for customer keys, on-disk key zeroization tests, KMS audit event mirroring to audit logs
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end SSO federations: create >2 test IdPs (Okta, Azure AD) and complete login flow; record SAML assertion samples and successful token exchange
RBAC correctness: run policy conformance suite (suite-id: RBAC-2026-03) with 100% pass for admin/operator/read-only matrices
Audit evidence: attach 7 days of synthetic traffic logs from staging showing retention, export to customer bucket, and searchability in ELK dashboard
KMS/HSM: perform key rotation exercise with automated rollout script (PR #3827) and demonstrate recovery with HSM quorum simulation
Security review: CISO signoff present, with risk register items < 3 and mitigations assigned
Docs & runbook: Confluence runbook linked, operator run steps validated by SRE and run once in DR environment
audit_evidence_requirements: SAML metadata files (raw XML) for each test IdP
Sample signed SAML assertions and verification logs
RBAC policy export CSV and conformance suite logs
Audit log samples (NDJSON) with schema v1.2 and proof of export to customer bucket
KMS access logs showing key-wrap/un-wrap events and rotation timestamps
HSM self-test output and quorum simulation recordings
rollout_plan: Canary in private region: enable features for internal pilot customers (2 accounts) for 72 hours
Operator dry-run: SRE executes full runbook in staging; capture time-to-complete and failure modes
Compliance window: freeze changes to auth/crypto surface 7 days before wide rollout
Fallbacks: if KMS binding fails, route to software-wrapped key variant and open auto-rollback ticket
Post-rollout audit: run evidence collection script at +24h and +7d and attach artifacts to ticket
open_dependencies: ENG-51421: CLI metadata import feature (blocks automated SAML import tests)
ENG-52390: audit-forwarder improvement to support WORM retention headers
PM-22469: key-escrow scope decision (affects KMS acceptance language)
DES-9982: operator runbook UI mocks for key rotation status
